name: MQTTy
blurb: A native GUI MQTT client development tool, with the purpose of debugging and testing IoT applications that makes use of the MQTT protocol.
description:
A native GUI MQTT client development tool, with the purpose of debugging and testing IoT
applications that makes use of the MQTT protocol.

Features:

• Publish to topics (In futures versions, it will also allow you to subscribe).

• Integrated code editor, with syntax highlighting for JSON and XML.

• Allows you to have multiple MQTT connections separated in different tabs

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
